t9: Workplace safety, one report at a time.
t17: From an identified hazard to a resolved incident. SafeWork connects workers and employers to report, take action and follow up on Android.
t33: Scattered messages, manual records and limited visibility make follow-up difficult. SafeWork brings reporting and incident handling into one workflow.

t41: Record the incident and its location, with coordinates or manual entry.
t43: The employer self-assigns and records the start and closure of the case.
t45: View status and account notifications in one place.

t63: Every step has a purpose and an owner. Select a stage to explore it.
t67: Describe what happened and record its location. The incident is open for handling.
t68: One company. One owner. A traceable case.
t70: Workers who report incidents and follow their progress from the workplace.
t72: Employers who take ownership of company incidents and record progress.
t74: Administrators who manage invitation-based onboarding and permissions through the API.
t78: Bring visibility to incidents and clarity to their handling, within each company.

t122: How do I get an account?
t123: Registration requires a valid invitation linked to your email and company. Onboarding is managed by an administrator or an authorized employer.
t124: Do I need an internet connection?
t125: Yes. Current flows retrieve and send data to the backend. Offline mode and automatic synchronization are not advertised.
t127: You can capture coordinates with device permissions or enter the report location manually.
t129: The current app is native Android, for Android 8.0 or later. This release does not include an iOS app.
t130: Can I download a public APK yet?
t131: Public APK download is being prepared. This page will link to the verified file once it is published; Google Play distribution is not enabled.

download.title: SafeWork,
download.description: The tested app connects workers and employers through reporting, responsibility and follow-up.
download.pending: Public download is being prepared. The APK is not available here yet.
download.step1body: Once the APK is published, download it and allow installation from the source you use to open it. Google Play distribution is not available.
download.step2body: An authorized person issues an invitation linked to your email and company. Invitations are shared by your company; automatic email delivery is not enabled.
download.step3: Create your account and log in
download.step3body: Register as WORKER with the invitation. EMPLOYER access is granted administratively.
video.fallback: Watch or download the product reference video.
screen.notifications: See updates addressed to your account.
flow.assigned: An employer from the company takes responsibility for the incident. The case is linked to that owner.
flow.started: Only the responsible employer starts handling the incident. Its status shows that work is in progress.
flow.closed: The responsible employer confirms closure. Users can view the status and notifications addressed to their account.
